teaser.en: Found only on the coasts of Kenya and Tanzania, this wild tree drops good fruit for anyone who knows where to look.
teaser.sw: Unapatikana tu katika pwani za Kenya na Tanzania, mti huu wa porini huangusha matunda mazuri kwa yeyote anayejua mahali pa kutafuta.

summary.en: *Mgama* is the coast mimusops, a medium-sized wild tree of the coastal forest and bush with edible fruit. It grows nowhere else in the world but coastal Kenya and Tanzania.
summary.sw: *Mgama* ni *coast mimusops*, mti wa porini wa ukubwa wa wastani wa misitu na vichaka vya pwani wenye matunda yanayoliwa. Haupatikani mahali pengine popote duniani isipokuwa pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

about.en: *Mgama* is a medium-sized tree. Its leaves are bunched in tight clusters at the ends of the shoots, which gives the crown a tufted look. Like other members of the Sapotaceae, the family of the sapodilla and the shea tree, it has milky sap and small, star-like flowers, and it bears small fleshy fruits.
about.sw: *Mgama* ni mti wa ukubwa wa wastani. Majani yake yamejikusanya katika vishada vilivyobanana kwenye ncha za machipukizi, jambo linalokipa kilele chake sura ya vishungi. Kama wanafamilia wengine wa Sapotaceae, familia ya *sapodilla* na mti wa shea, una utomvu kama maziwa na maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota, na huzaa matunda madogo yenye nyama.

where.en: *Mgama* grows in coastal forest and bushland, and only along the coasts of Kenya and Tanzania. On the south coast it belongs to the wild woodland rather than to farms and gardens.
where.sw: *Mgama* hukua katika misitu na vichaka vya pwani, na tu kando ya pwani za Kenya na Tanzania. Katika pwani ya kusini ni mti wa mapori ya asili badala ya mashamba na bustani.

uses.en: The fruits are good to eat and are gathered from the wild. The tree also gives timber and firewood, and its roots are used in veterinary medicine to treat livestock.
uses.sw: Matunda ni mazuri kuliwa na huchumwa porini. Mti pia hutoa mbao na kuni, na mizizi yake hutumika katika dawa za mifugo kutibu wanyama.

names.en: The Digo name is *mgama*. No Swahili or other Mijikenda name has been recorded for this species, and it has no well-known English name beyond 'coast mimusops'. One reference lists *mgama* under a related species, *Mimusops obtusifolia*, so the name may cover more than one coastal mimusops.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mgama*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la lugha nyingine ya Kimijikenda lililorekodiwa kwa spishi hii, na hauna jina la Kiingereza linalojulikana sana zaidi ya *coast mimusops*. Chanzo kimoja kinaorodhesha *mgama* chini ya spishi inayohusiana nayo, *Mimusops obtusifolia*, kwa hivyo huenda jina hili linahusu zaidi ya aina moja ya *mimusops* ya pwani.

conservation.en: It is a coastal East African endemic, found nowhere else, so the survival of the coastal forest and bush matters for its future.
conservation.sw: Ni mmea wa asili wa pwani ya Afrika Mashariki pekee, usiopatikana mahali pengine popote, kwa hivyo kudumu kwa misitu na vichaka vya pwani ni muhimu kwa mustakabali wake.

reason.en: Same family; a wild Manilkara with edible fruit
reason.sw: Familia moja; Manilkara wa porini mwenye matunda yanayoliwa
Mti mwingine wa Sapotaceae wa pwani

reason.sw: Kichaka cha Manilkara cha familia ile ile

reason.sw: Mti wa msituni wa familia ile ile
Mti mwingine wa porini wa matunda wa pwani
